protocol.cheap_baselines: ensemble standard deviation; prediction magnitude; distance to closest domain boundary; Gaussian-smoothed |r| sigma=1 cell
protocol.claim_scope: conditional on these trained networks and this coefficient/source family
protocol.energy: nonnegative face contributions summing to e^T A e, including Dirichlet boundary
protocol.evaluation: per-field spatial localization; no tuning or retraining
protocol.pcg: scipy CG, unpreconditioned / diagonal inverse / constant-coefficient Poisson inverse; zero start; 5/10/20/40/80 iterations
protocol.poisson_inverse: exact constant-coefficient TPFA inverse via orthonormal DST-II; coefficient=1; fixed per-grid preconditioner
protocol.predictor: frozen three-member FNO ensemble, training seeds 0,1,2
protocol.resampling_unit: independent coefficient fields; paired differences share fields
protocol.timing: AMG complexity is a rough structural estimate, not end-to-end work
